description: The serving contract (docs/hosting.md, decision 8), as requests to `respond` over the bundle in `bundle/` and what each gets. `store: true` answers with the store below too, which holds one pack file the bundle doesn't. Every implementation of `respond` (compmd-host's, @compmd/host's) runs these. A header that is null must be absent. Each path is one a URL parser leaves as it is: the Fetch API resolves `.` parts before a handler sees them, so a case of those is compmd-host's own.
